newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. up 5.4 pct Feb 21-28 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. up 5.4 pct Feb 21-28 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States rose 5.4 percent in the eight days of February 21-28 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos rose 5.8 percent, while U.S. sales of imports climbed 3.5 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales advanced 9.3 percent, to 156,079 from 142,864, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 2.6 percent, to 155,246 from 151,257, it said.
Import car sales rose 1.9 percent to 59,772, and import truck sales jumped 13.1 percent to 11,317, the report said.
Almost 2.1 million vehicles were sold in the United States so far in 1997, up 0.1 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
